character_archetype: Modern Wealth / Cash Manipulation Fighter (Basic Movement — No FX)

animations.gameplay_purpose: Default neutral standing stance when no directional or attack input is active.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 establishes canonical relaxed, alert standing fighting guard; F2–F6 cycle subtle chest breathing, shoulder relaxation, weight shift, and slight lead-hand guard adjustment; F7–F8 settle smoothly back to F1 for seamless looping.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Canonical hub state: transitions cleanly into Forward Walk F1, Backward Walk F1, Forward Dash F1, Backward Dash F1, Crouch Enter F1, and Jump Take-Off F1; receives recovery from Crouch Exit F2 and Landing F2.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Controlled forward neutral footsies movement toward the opponent while keeping guard ready.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 starts in fighting guard; F2–F4 execute full forward step, weight transfer, and rear-leg passing stride; F5 counterbalances arms; F6 settles cleanly into F1.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Enters from Idle F1 and returns cleanly to Idle F1 upon releasing forward input.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Defensive retreating movement and spacing control while facing the opponent and guarding.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 starts in standing guard facing RIGHT; F2–F4 step rear foot back, shift weight, and draw lead foot back; F5–F6 keep defensive guard up and reset to F1.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Always faces RIGHT; enters from and exits cleanly to Idle F1 without facing or scale pop.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Burst forward gap-closer for offense, whiff punishes, and rushdown.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 anticipation dip; F2 forward torso lean; F3 rear-foot push-off; F4 low athletic acceleration stride; F5 braking plant; F6 recovery into controlled standing fighting guard.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Enters from Idle F1; F6 matches Standing Guard / Idle F1 for seamless post-dash neutral or attack cancel.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Fast defensive evasive hop backward to escape pressure while maintaining opponent facing.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 standing guard facing RIGHT; F2 backward weight shift; F3 evasive push-off hop (feet lifted ~12 px above Y=272); F4 controlled backward landing; F5 stabilized standing guard facing RIGHT.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: All 5 frames face RIGHT; F5 aligns cleanly with Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Fast transition from standing guard into low crouching defensive stance.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 upright standing guard; F2 low crouching guard with knees bent, hips lowered, and feet grounded on Y=272.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: F1 matches Idle F1; F2 transitions directly into Crouch Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Sustained low defensive posture for crouching guard, ducking highs, and low normals.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 compact deep crouching guard; F2–F3 subtle breathing and defensive hand adjustment; F4 returns cleanly to F1.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Entered from Crouch Enter F2; exits cleanly into Crouch Exit F1 (identical compact crouch depth).

animations.gameplay_purpose: Snappy rise from deep crouching guard back to standing neutral.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 deep crouching guard matching Crouch Idle; F2 upright standing fighting guard with both feet grounded on Y=272.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: F1 matches Crouch Idle; F2 matches Idle F1 seamlessly.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Pre-jump startup anticipation and explosive upward launch.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 coiled anticipation crouch with arms pulled back and both feet grounded on Y=272; F2 explosive upward extension with arms raised and both feet visibly lifted off ground (bottom Y=250).
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Enters from Idle F1; F2 flows cleanly into Jump Airborne F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Airborne trajectory animation while the game engine drives vertical/horizontal jump arc physics.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 rising knee tuck; F2 mid-air guard adjustment; F3 apex tucked suspension; F4 descent preparation with legs reaching downward. Both feet remain visibly airborne above Y=272 across all 4 frames (bottom Y=243, 233, 223, 247).
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Entered from Jump Take-Off F2; F4 descent pose transitions directly into Landing F1 upon ground collision (engine may play F1→F4 once mapped to vertical velocity or loop mid-air).

animations.gameplay_purpose: Post-jump landing impact absorption and rapid recovery to neutral guard.
animations.starting_and_ending_pose_notes: F1 landing compression with knees bent absorbing impact and both feet grounded on Y=272; F2 upright stabilized standing fighting guard.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Receives transition from Jump Airborne F4; F2 matches Idle F1 seamlessly.
